subject: Class 707 in Southeastern livery
method: The 707's diagram (Southeastern) has the 700's doors, windows and nose to the pixel (both Desiro City; 707 car lengths as the 700's): the body and the shell's face geometry are the 700's as measured on 700142; what differs is measured on 707022 (EXIF focal 55 mm): no black mask beyond the glass's thin frame, and the yellow across the whole lower front, round the pods.

calibration.notes: cab car px 33 (nose tip, row 270) to 1708 = 20.52 m (published) -> 81.6 px/m; car 2 1765..3398 = 20.16 m -> 81.0 px/m; rail row 338.5, roof row 32 = 3.77 m -> 81.3 px/m

trace.face.707: p022 (707022, London Bridge): the windscreen glass in a thin dark frame on the navy, no wide black mask; yellow across the whole lower front from 1.16 to 1.93 m round both pods; navy cheeks below; the windscreen is as tall as the 700's mask (1.95-3.25 m, measured on the 700 through a solved camera): on 707022 the glass starts right on the yellow's top and reaches the destination display under the roof's curve, in a frame a few centimetres wide, so glass 1.99-3.21 m (by eye against the 700's numbers: p022's camera holds out at 22 cm, too loose to measure the face through)
trace.livery: p022 raw: navy #1F2D61 (sunlit side), yellow #FFCC2D (face), doors sky blue (diagram #00AFE8, toned down); an orange line over the cab roof
trace.body: dia (Southeastern 707 diagram) row 120: doors 492-635 and 1148-1291 px, windows 317-439, 689-870, 913-1094, 1344-1466, 1510-1632 px: the 700's to the pixel
trace.livery.branding: SE-light (the Southeastern wordmark with 'south' white instead of navy, as on the navy bodyside, 'eastern' sky blue): dia px 817-969, rows 205-224 at 81.6/81.3 px/m: 9.6-11.5 m, 1.40-1.64 m; car 2 px 2504-2670 from 1765 at 81.0 px/m: 9.1-11.2 m. 1.9 m long at the artwork's 8.75 aspect is 0.217 m tall
trace.face.outlines: 707022 (p022, near head-on from the right), scaled across by the lamps (tails 336 px apart for 2.38 m, heads 277 px for 1.98 m: 141 px/m) and up from the tails' centre (1.73 m): the windscreen is one trapezoid in a thin dark frame, +-1.11 m at its top (3.21 m) to +-0.88 m at its foot, which is the yellow's top (1.94 m); the glass within it to 3-4 cm; the yellow runs the full width from 1.155 to 1.94 m with the black pods set in it at its ends (0.80-1.33 m out, 1.50-1.89 m); below it navy cheeks and the coupler's recess between them, +-0.67 m, down to the face's foot (0.5 m; the photo's 0.45 m is below it). trace.face.pods: review (crop of 707022): measured on 707022 at 141 px/m from the tail lamps' 336 px spacing, centre 376.9 px, up from the tails at 1.73 m: each pod a slanted quadrilateral of dark smoked glass, its inner edge sharply angled along the centre panel's edge from 0.918 m out at 1.836 m to 0.811 m at 1.50 m, its top rising slightly outward to 1.88 m, its outer end rounded at 1.29-1.305 m, its foot rising outward to 1.63 m; two large round lamps nearly filling its height, the red tail outboard (1.193 m, 1.739 m, r 0.075) and the white headlamp inboard (0.95-1.01 m, 1.68 m, r 0.072); the yellow centre panel has its own outline (0.93 m at 1.90 m to 0.79 m at its foot); the number thin dark-red lettering; the seam drawn 3-4 cm inboard of the pods' inner edges (the joint and the pod's edge are a few cm apart on 707022); first render (a crop): the lamps read as small dots in a black box: the pod is dark smoked glass over a red LED cluster and a chrome headlamp nearly filling it, so the lamps are drawn glazed (Face.lampStyle) at their measured size; second render: the lamps still read small against the photo's (their lenses nearly fill the pod's height): tail r 0.095, head r 0.09; the number regular weight in a stronger red (light was barely visible); third pass (a closeup): the lenses are big round units nearly the pod's full height, side by side: tail r 0.105, head r 0.09; the unlit tail a red lens over its LEDs (Face.glazedTail); the centre panel's seam straight edges (a trapezoid following the pods' inner edges), not a rounded loop
